title: The demographic canon names two readers but none of the eleven archetypes or the three rules they add
detail: PR 1 of the demographic canon (ADR-1715). Replaces CONTENT-VOICE section 2 with two readers and eleven archetypes in four families (2d, 2f), the three archetype rules (2e) and the internal-names rule (2g); plain-ifies the section 1 mission line (no nervous-system language in the paragraph prompts paraphrase); adds activity-first and evidence-first clusters to 7a, splits the leader track in 7b into Host-Connector and Gathering Host, and opens the section 10 checklist with which reader and archetype. Rows LIVE-791 to LIVE-798 and HYG-170 carry PRs 2 to 10.

The demographic"),j=s.indexOf("## 3. The voice");if(i<0||j<i)fail("CONTENT-VOICE has no section 2");const t=s.slice(i,j);for(const n of ["Wired Professional","Transplant","Activity-First Man","Evidence-First Skeptic","Host-Connector","Gathering Host","Mission Patron","Portfolio Teacher","Second-Act Practitioner","Studio Keeper","Network Steward"])if(!t.includes(n))fail("CONTENT-VOICE section 2 does not name the "+n+" archetype");for(const x of ["Men come through activities","Write for the spiritual and the skeptic at once","Supporters pay so it stays free","Archetype names are internal"])if(!t.includes(x))fail("CONTENT-VOICE section 2 is missing the rule: "+x);if(/nervous system/i.test(s.slice(0,s.indexOf("## 1a."))))fail("section 1 still paraphrases nervous-system language into prompts and briefs")'
